boardTitle: Agentic AIBots: Production Systems, Autonomous Harnesses & Workflows
description: Production agentic bots from global enterprises and open-source projects ranked specifically on multi-step workflow automation, autonomy, governance, tool breadth, and production maturity.

qualificationRules.title: Agentic Bot Definition
qualificationRules.description: A product or runtime harness that autonomously plans, executes tool calls, manages state, and completes multi-step tasks across APIs, browsers, or terminal environments with limited human intervention (distinct from simple conversational chatbots).

qualificationRules.title: In Production Standard
qualificationRules.description: Generally Available (GA) commercial product or an actively maintained open-source repository with tagged releases in the past 90 days. Preview/beta bots are isolated and only appear when the 'Include Previews' toggle is active.

qualificationRules.title: Strict Verification Policy
qualificationRules.description: Every entry requires an official source URL (documentation, release notes, or verified GitHub repository) and a 'Verified' status badge. Unverified tools are flagged and omitted from default rankings.

qualificationRules.title: No Duplication with Other Boards
qualificationRules.description: Raw model benchmarks (e.g. MMLU, GSM8K, LMSYS Arena Elo) and aggregate token volumes belong on LLM Intelboard and AgentEvals. This board evaluates bot-level systems: the complete product, execution harness, sandboxing, tool coverage, human gates, and enterprise adoption.

scoringFormula.name: Agentic Readiness Score (ARS)
scoringFormula.formula: ARS = (Reliability × w1) + (Autonomy × w2) + (Tool Breadth × w3) + (Governance × w4) + (Production Maturity × w5) + (Ecosystem × w6)

descriptions.reliability: Task completion reliability across standardized agentic benchmarks (GAIA, Tau-bench pass^k, WebArena, OSWorld) and error recovery rate.
descriptions.autonomy: Longest autonomous execution horizon without intervention, and published low human-intervention rates.
descriptions.toolBreadth: Volume of prebuilt connectors, native MCP (Model Context Protocol) client/server support, browser/desktop execution, and custom tool extensibility.
descriptions.governance: Enterprise RBAC, sandboxed execution (MicroVM/Docker), cryptographic audit logs, configurable human-in-the-loop approval gates, and CVE history.
descriptions.productionMaturity: SLA guarantees, deployment flexibility (VPC, self-hosted, cloud), time-to-production, and multi-agent coordination patterns.
descriptions.ecosystem: Active developer community, GitHub stars/forks, release velocity, PyPI/npm package downloads, or verified enterprise customer deployments.
